title: Which Argumentative Aspects of Hate Speech in Social Media can be reliably identified?

bias_targets.methodology: Annotating the argumentative structure (Collectives, Properties, Justifications, Conclusions, and Pivots) of hate speech tweets targeting immigrants from the HatEval corpus, and evaluating the performance of fine-tuned language models (e.g., RoBERTa, BERTweet, XLM-RoBERTa) in automatically identifying and extracting these xenophobic and biased argumentative components.
